theme: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

reports.title: Tom Cribley
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

concerns.quote: failure to document the rash that Tom presented with when he arrived at AED which was not recorded at triage
concerns.hazard: failure to document rash at triage

concerns.quote: failure to complete a full "PIT STOP" review
concerns.hazard: failure to complete PIT STOP review

concerns.quote: failure to review the initial diagnosis of gastroenteritis when Tom's condition continued to deteriorate
staff to handover clinical concerns to each other and to medical staff including face to face handovers
failure to escalate monitoring and management appropriately in particular following receipt of the first set of grossly abnormal blood results
concerns.hazard: failure to escalate abnormal blood results

reports.title: Joan Coley
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

promises.quote: Write to all UK Postgraduate Deans to request that they ensure their induction programmes for Foundation doctors are in protected time; include best practice; and, reinforce the requirements of Foundation Professional Capability 18: recognises and works within limits of personal competence;
promises.summary: Request protected induction programmes for Foundation doctors to reinforce competence limits

concerns.quote: very limited training on how to take bloods from a central line, the physiology involved and potential risks
taking bloods from a central line is not part of the "check list" of tasks that junior doctors have to undertake
concerns.hazard: absence of checklist for central line blood draws

concerns.quote: there was no formal system for assessing a doctor's competence to 5 undertake a particular task for example, taking bloods from a central line
concerns.hazard: lack of competence assessment for central line blood draws

concerns.quote: there was no system of hand over when junior doctors change from ward to ward
concerns.hazard: inadequate handover of competency between wards

concerns.quote: general lack of understanding of how to take bloods from a central line and the associated risks
concerns.hazard: lack of understanding of central line blood draw risks

concerns.quote: no standard written procedure for taking bloods from a central line
concerns.hazard: absence of standard operating procedure for central line blood draws

links.explanation: Both reports identify problems with the handover of clinical information or competencies between staff members. The earlier report focuses on general clinical staff handovers, while the later report specifies a missing handover system for junior doctors moving between wards.
links.earlier_quote: the failure of clinical staff to handover clinical concerns to each other and to medical staff including face to face handovers
links.later_quote: The inquest heard how there was no system of hand over when junior doctors change from ward to ward.
